title: Retry loop has no upper bound
summary: LoginClient.retry retries on every 5xx with no attempt limit, so an outage keeps the client in a tight loop.

sources.excerpt: 1. The retry loop in LoginClient never stops on repeated 503s.

research.analysis: The loop at LoginClient.swift:88 retries while the status is 5xx. Backoff exists, but no attempt cap.

options.title: Cap at 3 attempts
options.description: Add maxAttempts = 3 and surface the last error.

options.title: Cap from remote config
options.description: Read the cap from a config flag with default 3.

options.title: Not needed
cons: Client still loops if the gateway is unreachable
